title: Change default first-launch language to English
description: Product decision reversal: LODGY-30 was built with Hindi as the first-launch default per an earlier explicit requirement ('primary users are Hindi-based'). Product Owner has since reversed that - default should be English on first launch. The switcher itself (LODGY-30, More -> App language) is unaffected; only AppLocale.applyDefaultIfUnset()'s default value changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh install with no locale preference set defaults to English, not Hindi
Existing installs that already have an explicit choice stored (Hindi or English) are unaffected - this only changes the unset-default case
Hindi remains fully available and switchable at any time via the existing More -> App language picker

history.note: Added following backlog review: splitting LODGY-39, giving LODGY-37/45 a shared PDF prerequisite, and folding in the latest round of direct feedback (a real delete-without-confirmation bug hit on Rooms, a default-language reversal, and new notification/navigation-polish requests).

Rationale confirmed, not just tester convenience: in practice the phone is often set up by someone other than the warden (a son, a shop tech doing the install) who is more comfortable in English than the warden ultimately using the app day-to-day. English-by-default plus an easy, prominent switch to Hindi (LODGY-30) serves both people better than defaulting to the warden's own language and hoping the installer notices the switcher exists.
Starting - single-value change in AppLocale.applyDefaultIfUnset(), plus the matching current() fallback so an unset locale reads back as the same language it would be applied as.

AppLocale.applyDefaultIfUnset() now applies ENGLISH, and current()'s unset fallback matches it so a fresh install reads back the same language it was given. The isEmpty guard is unchanged, so any install that already stored a choice - including Hindi picked under the old default - is untouched; the More -> App language picker still offers both. AppLocaleTest updated for the new default. testDebugUnitTest green.
